_doc: Painted dusk plates behind every fighter image (final parity client F3, art half): art/blender/common/plates.py. A fighter listed under `fighters` renders portrait.png / splash.png (and every <skin>_portrait.png / <skin>_splash.png) over a painted plate cut from art/out/backdrops/<src>.webp and graded to dusk for its origin (spec.ORIGIN), with the subject lit to match (key / fill / rims). A skin line (the skin id after '<fighter>_') may pick its own painting under `lines`; the origin grade and light stay. Keys and defaults: plates.DEFAULTS. Re-render: python3 art/build.py portraits <id> --only splash,portrait (base) and --skins (every skin, from its GLB). Re-compose from the kept subject passes without Blender: python3 art/blender/common/plates.py compose [sids]; measure: python3 art/blender/common/plates.py measure (gate: the 3:5 loading crop and the draft-cell crop at p50 70-110 luma, at most a small share above 200).
